slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Surface area: prism, the sum of all face areas (2B + Ph for a right prism). Cylinder, 2πr2 + 2πrh. Regular pyramid, B + (1/2)Pℓ. Cone, πr2 + πrℓ. Sphere, 4πr2.

Here ℓ is the slant height, measured along the face, which is longer than the height h. Unfold a solid into its net and add the areas of the pieces; the curved side of a cylinder unrolls into a rectangle 2πr by h.
